prose.text: "Is this URL blocked, and by which rule?" needs four questions answered in order. Skipping one is how precedence answers go wrong.

steps.label: Does URL Filtering run at all?
steps.text: A Cloud App Control allow skips it unless cascading is on, and Bypass Other Policies skips it entirely: [[zia.cloud-app-control.precedence]], [[zia.ssl-inspection.pipeline]].

steps.label: Which category is the URL in?
steps.text: Resolved before rules, by most-specific entry across custom categories and by Retain Parent for predefined ones: [[zia.url-categories.membership]], with entry syntax in [[zia.url-categories.entry-matching]].

steps.label: Which rules' criteria match?
steps.text: The criteria expression, including the AND between two URL Categories fields and what is visible before decryption: [[zia.url-filtering.criteria]].

steps.label: Which matching rule is first?
steps.text: First match by ascending order, with disabled rules holding their slot: [[zia.url-filtering.rule-order]].

prose.text: The answer is then that rule's action and its prerequisites: [[zia.url-filtering.actions]]. Tenant-wide settings can change the outcome without any rule changing: [[zia.url-filtering.advanced-settings]].
Before reasoning over a tenant's rules, make sure the list is complete: [[zia.url-filtering.list-pagination]].
